result.title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents
result.summary: Visual content in multimedia systems may be resized, compressed, or re-rendered before it is interpreted by a vision-language model. We study a security failure mode in which these transformations change the machine-readable semantics of an image: a textual instruction is not recovered at a $512\times512$ presentation resolution under our evaluation protocol but becomes recoverable after aggressive downsampling. We formulate this behavior as Scale-Induced Semantic Shift (SISS) and develop a closed-loop black-box framework that combines dual-scale verification, selective self-hardening, shallow-layer low-rank adaptation, and pixel-space noise regularization. On a fixed 300-case benchmark, the third SISS refinement round obtains a $58.75\%$ average attack success rate across four closed-source vision-language models, compared with $41.08\%$ for the strongest generation baseline. A controlled sweep bounds the effect to aggressive compression: average success decreases to $17.68\%$, $6.85\%$, and $5.60\%$ at $128\times128$, $224\times224$, and $336\times336$, respectively. In a downstream web-agent study, the generated images increase hidden-instruction perception, but absolute behavioral compromise remains about $4\%$. Generic input transformations provide little protection in a separate defense protocol, whereas the proposed ScaleGuard consistency detector reduces non-adaptive success from $61.4\%$ to $24.3\%$ and one-round defense-aware success from $42.5\%$ to $15.0\%$, with no observed rejection among matched clean controls. The results characterize a bounded but reproducible semantic inconsistency in multimedia preprocessing and motivate scale-consistent visual-language inference.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「尺度诱导语义偏移」(SISS)：同一图像中的文本指令在 512×512 呈现下不可读，经强下采样后反可被 VLM 读取；据此构建黑盒闭环攻击框架（双尺度验证、选择性自硬化、浅层 LoRA、像素噪声正则），在 300 例基准上取得 58.75% 平均攻击成功率，并配套 ScaleGuard 一致性检测与 web agent 行为评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对分辨率与压缩改变视觉内容「可读语义」的刻画，可供核查 LVR 中下采样、视觉 token 压缩与细节保真之间的关系，以及视觉证据能否被内部状态读出、latent 相似度是否受预处理尺度影响；但该工作属对抗安全场景，未涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用。
